integrity: New all-size conclusions have analytic proofs. Accompanying finite enumeration and floating-point checks are corroborative only. Public source access limitations are stated explicitly. No independent audit or independent validation is claimed.
limitations: Not for noncommuting or three-and-higher-local interactions, qudits, or unrestricted coefficient amplification. Full primary text of motivating September 2026 paper was not accessible for comparison; implicit prior specialization remains possible.
scientific_scope: Finite qubit Hamiltonians with mutually commuting, distinct nonidentity one- and two-site Pauli strings of coefficients bounded in magnitude after merging repeats. Universal threshold restricted to overlap-degree bounds at least two.
title: Sharp separability frontier and cut negativities of commuting two-local Pauli Gibbs states
